items.entity: Base support: whole clamped base vs. four corner supports
items.description: Nanopillar section: '12,800 are passive atoms from the clamped base'; Methods: passive atoms are 'held fixed in all Cartesian directions'. With a0 = 4.05 Å, 12,800 = 40x40x2 cells x 4 atoms, a full-footprint slab 2 unit cells thick, which would clamp the whole bottom face. The same section says the pillar 'is supported at the four corners of the base' and mentions 'the four corner supports' that the legs run to. Which nodes are fixed is never stated outright (probably shown in Figs. S17/S18).
readings: Only four corner regions of the bottom face (z=0) fixed (u_x=u_y=u_z=0); rest of the bottom face free
Entire bottom face fixed (full passive base slab fully fixed)
Full-footprint passive base slab included as solid material but fixed only at its four corners

items.entity: Size/shape of each corner support
items.description: Nanopillar section and Discussion say only 'supported at the four corners of the base' / 'four corner supports'. No footprint for the corner supports is given; Supp. Note A.14 and Figs. S17/S18 aren't available.
readings: Single node (point support) at each of the four bottom corners
Square patch per corner, side 20.25 Å (5 unit cells, 0.125 W, W = 162 Å)
Square patch per corner, side 40.5 Å (10 unit cells, 0.25 W)

items.entity: 12,800 passive base atoms as a non-design region in the FE model
items.description: Nanopillar section lists 640,000 active and 12,800 passive atoms 'from the clamped base' but gives no geometry. 12,800 fits a full 162x162x8.1 Å slab (40x40x2 cells) and also four corner blocks (e.g. 10x10x8 cells). The text doesn't say whether FEM-TO models this region as solid non-design elements or only as fixed nodes.
readings: No passive elements; base represented only by nodal constraints
Non-design solid slab over the full 162x162 Å footprint, 8.1 Å thick (2 unit cells, z = 0 to 8.1 Å)
Four non-design solid corner blocks, each 40.5x40.5x32.4 Å (10x10x8 unit cells)

items.entity: Height of the FE design grid
items.description: The domain is given as 162.00 x 162.00 x 413.10 Å (40x40x102 unit cells), but only 640,000 atoms (40x40x100 cells, 405.0 Å tall) are active; the other 2 cells are passive base. It's unclear whether the FEM-TO design domain spans 413.10 Å or only the active 405.0 Å.
readings: 162 x 162 x 413.10 Å (102 unit cells, base included in the grid)
162 x 162 x 405.0 Å (100 unit cells, active region only; base handled as a boundary condition)

items.entity: Extent of the loaded region at the top centre
items.description: Nanopillar section and Methods: vertical displacement 'applied at the center of the top surface'. The Fig. 6a caption mentions only a red arrow, and no patch size is given anywhere.
readings: Single node at (0.5W, 0.5W) on the top face
Small central square patch, side 8.1 Å (2 unit cells, 0.05 W)
Central patch the size of the initial column's top face, side 72.9 Å (0.45 W)

items.entity: Load type in the FEM-TO run (force vs. prescribed displacement)
items.description: The atomistic runs are displacement-controlled (Methods: delta_pillar = 1% of pillar height). The text doesn't say how the load enters the FEM-TO compliance problem. Force and displacement control only give the same result for a single-node load, not for a loaded patch.
readings: Concentrated vertical nodal force at the centre node
Uniform vertical traction over the central patch
Prescribed uniform vertical displacement of the patch (rigid punch), maximizing reaction stiffness

items.entity: Lateral DOFs of the loaded top-centre nodes
items.description: Nanopillar section and Methods say only that a 'vertical displacement' is applied at the top centre. They don't say whether the loaded atoms/nodes are free or held in x and y.
readings: Only u_z loaded/prescribed; u_x and u_y free
Loaded nodes also fixed laterally (u_x = u_y = 0)

items.entity: Solid non-design pad under the load
items.description: Only the base atoms are said to be passive; no passive region at the top is mentioned. The text doesn't say whether FEM-TO kept the elements under the top-centre load solid.
readings: No non-design region at the load
Small solid non-design pad under the load patch (1-2 elements deep)

items.entity: Magnitude of the vertical load
items.description: Only the atomistic displacement is given: 1% of 'pillar height' (Methods). The height could be 413.10 Å or the active 405.0 Å, and no FE force value is given.
readings: Unit force (arbitrary scale)
Prescribed displacement 4.131 Å (1% of 413.10 Å)
Prescribed displacement 4.05 Å (1% of 405.0 Å)

items.entity: Reference volume for the 20.25% target
items.description: Nanopillar section: 'target mass ratio is only 20.25%'. 'Mass ratio' isn't defined for the pillar: it could be relative to the 640,000 active atoms or to the 652,800-atom block including the passive base. 0.2025 = 0.45^2, which fits an 18x18-cell (72.9 Å) column over the active region.
readings: Volume fraction 0.2025 of the active design region (129,600 atoms)
0.2025 of the whole domain with the passive base counted as solid (about 0.187 of the design region)

items.entity: Young's modulus of continuum Al in FEM-TO
items.description: Only the Mishin EAM potential and a0 = 4.05 Å are specified (Methods). No continuum modulus is given for the FEM-TO benchmark (Supp. Note A.14).
readings: E = 70 GPa (bulk Al)
E = 1 (normalized)
E derived from the EAM-fitted bulk elastic constants

items.entity: Poisson's ratio in FEM-TO
items.description: No Poisson's ratio is given anywhere for the continuum benchmark.

items.entity: Elastic symmetry of the continuum model
items.description: The paper says only that Al bulk elasticity is 'nearly isotropic' and that cube axes align with x, y, z. It doesn't say whether FEM-TO used isotropic or cubic elasticity.
readings: Isotropic linear elastic
Cubic anisotropic Al with cube axes along x, y, z

items.entity: FEM-TO structured-grid resolution
items.description: Neither the element size nor the element count for the FEM-TO run is given (Supp. Note A.14 not provided). The mesh also affects how the layout is mapped onto the FCC lattice.
readings: 40x40x102 (or x100) hexahedra, 4.05 Å = one FCC unit cell per element
80x80x204 (or x200) hexahedra, 2.025 Å = one atomic-plane spacing
Coarser 20x20x51 grid (8.1 Å elements)

items.entity: FEM-TO filter type
items.description: Only the Nano-TO atomistic sensitivity filter (Eq. 9) is described. The FEM-TO regularization isn't stated.
readings: Sensitivity filter with linear cone weights
Density filter with linear cone weights
Density filter plus Heaviside projection

items.entity: FEM-TO filter radius
items.description: r_min = 10.325 Å is given for Nano-TO only (Methods, Sensitivity filtering). No radius is given for FEM-TO.
readings: r_min = 10.325 Å (same physical radius; about 2.5 elements on a 4.05 Å mesh)
r_min = 1.5 element widths
r_min = 3 element widths

items.entity: Material interpolation / penalization
items.description: No SIMP exponent, minimum stiffness or continuation scheme is given for FEM-TO.
readings: SIMP p = 3, Emin = 1e-9 E
SIMP with continuation p = 1 to 3
SIMP p = 4

items.entity: Optimizer, move limit and stopping rule
items.description: The update scheme and convergence rule are described for Nano-TO only (80/80 atom swaps, stopped at 3,000 iterations). The FEM-TO optimizer and iteration count are not specified.
readings: OC, move limit 0.2, stop when max density change < 0.01
MMA, stop when change < 0.01 or after 200 iterations
Fixed iteration budget (e.g. 500 iterations)

items.entity: FEM-TO initial design
items.description: Nano-TO starts from a uniform prismatic column at 20.25% (nanopillar section). The FEM-TO starting density field isn't stated.
readings: Uniform density 0.2025 everywhere
Centred solid 72.9 x 72.9 Å (0.45 W) prismatic column over the full height, void elsewhere

items.entity: Symmetry enforcement
items.description: Mirror symmetry is mentioned only for the cantilevers. Nothing is said about enforcing symmetry in the pillar FEM-TO run.
readings: No symmetry enforced (full model)
Quarter symmetry about x = 0.5W and y = 0.5W
Full square symmetry including diagonal mirror planes

items.entity: Mapping the FEM-TO density field onto the FCC lattice
items.description: Continuum benchmark paragraph: 'the resulting layout is mapped onto the same FCC lattice'. No threshold, mass-matching or cleanup rule is given, so the binary design in Fig. S18 can't be reproduced exactly.
readings: Atom real if its containing element's density >= 0.5
Rank-order threshold to keep exactly 20.25% of active atoms (129,600)
Threshold, then remove disconnected/floating atoms

locator: Supplementary Note A.14, the nanopillar designed by FEM-TO (Fig. S18)
